title: iPod Touch - Wikipedia
snippet:
The iPod Touch (stylized as iPod touch) is a discontinued line of iOS-based mobile devices designed and formerly marketed by Apple with a touchscreen-controlled user interface. As with other iPod models, the iPod Touch can be used as a portable media player and a handheld gaming device, but can also be used as a digital camera, a web browser, and for email and messaging. It is nearly identical in design to the iPhone, and can run most iPhone third-party apps from the App Store "App Store [...] The iPod Touch was the last product in Apple's iPod product line after the discontinuation of the iPod Nano and iPod Shuffle on July 27, 2017, after which Apple revised the storage and pricing for the iPod Touch with 32 and 128 GB of storage. On May 10, 2022, Apple discontinued the iPod Touch, effectively ending the iPod product line. The last iOS version to support the seventh-generation iPod Touch is iOS 15.

title: Here's where you can still buy an iPod touch - 9to5Mac
snippet:
While we don’t have exact inventory counts, here’s what we know is in stock. We’ll continue to update periodically as inventory changes.

## Apple

On Apple’s website, the iPod touch is completely sold out.

## Best Buy

Best Buy is sold out of all of the 32GB options with the exception of the Space Gray model. For 128GB, you can still buy a Blue and a Space Gray. Additionally, all of the 256GB models are out of stock. [...] ## Walmart

Walmart is where you’ll find some of the best prices for an iPod touch. 32GB is no longer available in Blue or (PRODUCT)RED. The 128GB is available in Space Gray and Pink. Walmart is entirely sold out of 256GB options as those seem to be the most popular models at many retailers.

## Amazon

The iPod touch is currently listed as a best seller on Amazon and there’s even a 5% discount on what’s available. The 32GB is available in Pink, Space Gray, and Gold. [...] Go to the 9to5Mac home page

After Apple announced it is discontinuing the iPod touch (7th generation) yesterday and retiring the iPod altogether, consumers have been rushing to retailers in-store and online to buy one of these devices. The product is only being sold at retailers while supplies last.

title: Apple Has Officially Discontinued The iPod Nano And Shuffle, Reduces Price Of The iPod Touch
snippet: Previously, you had four configuration options for the iPod Touch: the 16GB model was priced at $199, 32 GB model was priced at $249, 64GB variant was priced at $299 and finally the 128GB variant was available for $399. To be exact, the price of the 32GB variant has been reduced by $50 while $100 have been reduced for the 128GB model. [...] Apart from Apple discontinuing the iPod Nano and iPod Shuffle, Apple has also adjusted the price of its iPod Touch with updated configuration. The company is now offering the iPod Touch in 32GB and 128GB configuration. The prior will cost you $199 while the latter is priced at $299 in the United States. Moreover, 32GB is the base line storage option for the iPod Touch now as the 16GB variant has been discontinued along with 64GB option. [...] The new configurations are available in stock at the moment on Apple's online store. Moreover, they are offered in the same color options as previously, that is Space Gray, Silver, Gold, Blue, Pink and Red. In addition to this, Apple updated the iPod Touch back in 2015, in which it updated the device's camera to 8-megapixel rear facing iSight camera and also incorporated the Apple A8 chip. You can get your hands on the iPod Touch from Apple's online store.
